story.heading: Hibachi and sushi in four towns
paragraphs: Ooka Hibachi and Sushi lists four towns on the current homepage: Doylestown, Willow Grove, Montgomeryville, and Riverside.
The live root URL currently shows a page-not-found overlay on a sushi-case photo. Willow Grove is at 1109 Easton Road. Doylestown, Montgomeryville, and Riverside stay on the map as printed towns.
